body.name: Poison Vial
body.description: It is said to contain a blend of toxins from the deadliest beasts in the realm. When broken, this vial releases a poisonous fog that lingers in the air, draining the life from those foolish enough to inhale it.
body.effect: Throwing the vial creates a poison cloud that lasts for 6 seconds. Targets within the poison cloud take 10 magical damage per second.
